title: A deepened tech sell-off drags Asian stocks lower as markets in South Korea and Japan sink
description: Asian shares are falling sharply with markets in South Korea and Japan sinking as a sell-off of technology shares deepens. The declines in Asian shares follows losses on Wall Street after hotter-than-expected inflation data in the U.S. South Korea's benchmark Kospi index tumbled nearly 8% Thursday, while Japan's Nikkei 225 plunged 5%. U.S. futures are also trading lower. The U.S. reported Wednesday that the consumer price index rose 3.7% year-on-year in September, worse than what economists had expected. Wall Street's S&P 500 slid 1.1%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 0.1%, and the technology-heavy Nasdaq composite slipped 1.9% as artificial intelligence-related stocks fell.

title: Inflation anxiety drags on AI stocks for a second day as markets point to a mixed open
description: Trading on Wall Street is mixed early with tech stocks poised for more declines as earnings season ramps up amid the latest government data showing that inflation remains a problem in the U.S. Futures for the S&P 500 were down 0.2% before the opening bell Thursday, while futures for the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.3%. Nasdaq futures tumbled 1%. Artificial intelligence stocks were down again after taking a beating a day earlier. A government inflation report on Wednesday showed that prices remain well above the Federal Reserve’s 2% target, putting in play another potential interest rate hike before the end of the year.
content:

title: Social service agencies need safeguards when using AI

title: Physical AI in Manufacturing: How computer vision, robotics and edge automation are moving into the real world
description: Physical AI is taking artificial intelligence beyond software and into factories, hospitals and other real-world environments. Computer vision, spatial systems, robotics and edge computing are enabling machines to interpret and respond to their surroundings. For enterprises, scaling these capabilities depends on reliable infrastructure, safety, integration and clear operational value.
